definitions.gloss: to unite; to band together; to rally together
definitions.explanation: To come together as a group with a common purpose or cause. Often used in the context of solidarity, teamwork, or collective action.

examples.japanese: みんなで{団結|だんけつ}しよう。
チームが{団結|だんけつ}して{試合|しあい}に{勝|か}った。
examples.english: The team united and won the game.

examples.japanese: {住民|じゅうみん}たちは{開発|かいはつ}に{反対|はんたい}して{団結|だんけつ}し、{署名|しょめい}を{集|あつ}めた。
examples.english: The residents banded together against the development and collected signatures.

notes:
{団結|だんけつ}する means to unite with a shared purpose. Often used for collective action — labor movements, sports teams, community organizing.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Pattern: (みんなで){団結|だんけつ}する

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {団結|だんけつ}{力|りょく}: unity, solidarity, power of unity
- {団結|だんけつ}を{固|かた}める: to strengthen unity
- {固|かた}く{団結|だんけつ}する: to firmly/solidly unite
- {団結|だんけつ}して{立|た}ち{向|む}かう: to unite and stand up against

RELATED WORDS:
- {結束|けっそく}: unity, solidarity (similar but slightly more formal)
- {連帯|れんたい}: solidarity (emphasizes connection/support)
- {協力|きょうりょく}: cooperation (broader, less about unity)
